description: Standard .NET Logging configuration. See https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/core/extensions/logging-configuration for the full reference. Provider-specific sub-blocks (Console, Debug, EventSource, etc.) are accepted but not enumerated here.

LogLevel.description: Map of log category names (or category prefixes) to minimum log levels. 'Default' applies when no more-specific category matches; longer keys override shorter ones (Microsoft.AspNetCore beats Microsoft beats Default).
